title: The Turning
author: claude-code — a Terra/Gaia showcase composing terrain felt (52) + art felt (232) + verified rotation-addressability + the terrain<->object interaction rule
thesis: A season sweeps across one landscape, NW->SE: alpine winter -> autumn woods -> a still summer lake -> a tropical delta. A river+lake is the spine; the land turns around it. Terrain is the mood, gaia is the life, and they are chosen TOGETHER — every tree stands on the floor that belongs to it, every water carries the depth and tint its scene needs.

map.note: blank all-grass; paint the regions below onto it, then place gaia.

the_water_spine.form: A river enters top-left (NW, ~[8,8]) from a frozen alpine tarn, runs diagonally to a central LAKE (~centre [60,60], ~26 tiles across), then out bottom-right (SE, ~[112,112]) fanning into a brackish DELTA at the map edge.
the_water_spine.depth_discipline: Water is NEVER one tile-type. Paint concentric depth: DEEP(22) at centres/channel, MEDIUM(23) around it, SHALLOW(1) at every edge, then a 1-2 tile WET-BEACH(80) shore, then BEACH-VEGETATION(52) or grass. This gradient is the single most important craft in the piece.
the_water_spine.tint_by_region: Frozen tarn = ICE(35)+ICE-NAVIGABLE(26). Alpine/autumn river = clear SHALLOW(1)/MEDIUM(23)/DEEP(22). Lake = clear, a touch of AZURE(58) in the shallows. Delta = GREEN(95) then BROWN(96) then WEED(130) as it turns brackish and slow.

regions.name: Alpine Source (NW corner)
regions.terrain_notes: SNOW(32) floor, SNOW-SOFT(124) in the purest drifts, SNOW-FOREST-FLOOR(105) under the conifers. The tarn: ICE(35) with ICE-NAVIGABLE(26) at its heart, ICE-BEACH(37) rim.

gaia.note: BARE oaks (rot 9 = winter skeleton) at the tree-line
rock terrain outcrops via ROCK(40) patches, not units

regions.name: Boreal Slope (N band)
regions.terrain_notes: SNOW-FOREST-FLOOR(105) fading to generic FOREST(10) as it warms; ROCK(40) where the river tumbles; a WATERFALL feel via a rock band + karst.

gaia.note: karst spires flanking the river drop

regions.name: Autumn Woods (centre-N, the river's middle)
regions.terrain_notes: FOREST(10) floor with DRY-GRASS(100) clearings and DIRT(6) trodden paths to the water; MUD(76) at the wet bank.

gaia.note: maple-GOLD leaf litter under the oaks
a Sacred Tree on the river bend — the reverent pause

regions.name: The Lake & its Island (centre)
regions.terrain_notes: The full water gradient: DEEP(22) centre -> MEDIUM(23) -> SHALLOW(1)/AZURE(58) rim -> WET-BEACH(80) -> BEACH-VEGETATION(52) -> GRASS2(12). A small ISLAND of GRASS2(12) at the lake's heart.

gaia.note: a second Sacred Tree crowning the island — the map's still point
weeping WILLOWS drooping to the water — the piece's signature
water lilies floating the azure rim
green oaks, evergreen, framing the summer side

regions.name: Summer Meadow (E band, the sun side)
regions.terrain_notes: lush GRASS2(12) with GRASS-FLOWERS(122) meadows and a GRASS(0) fringe — the healthiest, most alive ground on the map.

regions.name: Tropical Delta (SE corner, the river's end)
regions.mood: warm, wet, teeming, the outflow to the sea
regions.terrain_notes: JUNGLE-GRASS(60) and green FOREST-FLOOR(56) under the canopy; MANGROVE-FLOOR(55) where the river fans brackish; water turns GREEN(95)->BROWN(96)->WEED(130); AZURE(58) sea beyond a WHITE-BEACH(53) strand.

gaia.note: MANGROVES — placed ONLY on the mangrove-floor(55), roots in the brackish water (the interaction rule made visible)
oyster beds on the tidal flat
karst sea-stacks rising from the azure
a beached whale on the strand — the far, quiet note

craft_rules_for_the_compiler: SEAM every region boundary: never a hard edge. Use the seam_terrain (a transition ground) or a 2-3 tile blend band between adjacent regions (snow->snow-forest->forest; forest->dry-grass->grass2->grass-flowers; grass->beach-veg->wet-beach->water).

INTERACTION RULE is law: mangroves ONLY on mangrove-floor(55) with roots in water; reeds/lilies ONLY on shallow water; snow trees on snow-forest-floor(105); a tree's biome comes from the TREE, its floor from the terrain — pair them.
WATER DEPTH is always graded (deep->medium->shallow->wet-beach->shore). No unit sits on the wrong water (fish/lilies float, trees never in deep water).
SEASON is expressed by ROTATION where the map is engine-verified: bare oak=rot 9-11/15-17/24-26, autumn-gold oak=18-23, crimson maple=rot 0. Winter->autumn->summer trees follow the band.

RESTRAINT: a landscape breathes. Scatter loosely; let terrain and open ground carry stretches. Density rises at focal moments (the two Sacred Trees, the willowed island, the karst, the whale), falls between.
COMPOSITION: the two Sacred Trees (autumn bend + lake island) and the willowed island are the focal spine; the eye should travel the river from the cold white source to the warm azure delta.
